Aksharaa Haasan discusses parental legacy and personal identity

Actress Aksharaa Haasan stated that her parents, actors Kamal Haasan and Sarika, provided her and her sister Shruti Haasan with the freedom to forge their own identities. She believes they now have the responsibility to protect the legacy established by their parents. Haasan emphasized that this freedom allowed them to build their own paths.
